name: Standing dumbbell curl
instructions: Stand facing the camera, full upper body in frame, a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight. Curl both weights up together, then lower under control until the arms are straight again.

cues.message: Curl a little higher — you are stopping short of the top
Your upper arms are swinging forward — keep the elbows under the shoulders

knownLimitations: EXPERIMENTAL: no physical validation has been performed. Thresholds are engineering guesses, not measured values.
Bilateral only. Alternating curls will read as partial repetitions on both arms.
Upper-arm drift is measured in the image plane, so drift straight towards the camera is invisible from the front view.
Wrist supination is not measured; a hammer curl scores identically to a supinated curl.
unsupportedViews: SIDE: the far arm is occluded, and a bilateral average of one visible arm is not a bilateral measurement.
